Appendix: R code of the harmonisation

The scripts below build the harmonised series from the WHO raw files. They run in this order from the project root, each sourcing code/functions_pm.R: Rscript code/01_areas.R, Rscript code/02_cause_groups.R, Rscript code/03_who_deaths.R and Rscript code/04_area_series.R (README.md). They are shown in full, with line numbers, as read from the scripts when this page was rendered; they are not run here. The other scripts linked above, code/05_cohort_sdg34.R, code/07_tobacco_lag.R, code/09_shares_generation.R and Study/code/02_replication.R, use the harmonised series in the analyses; they will be published with their components.

code/functions_pm.R: Prem_mortality helpers: paths, WHO raw-file harmonisation (ages, gaps), outputs (dictionary, figures, theme); steps ‘Raw files’, ‘Ages’, ‘Gaps and interpolation’ and ‘From countries to areas’ of Table 1.8 (91 lines; on GitHub) 
## Prem_mortality helpers: paths, WHO raw-file harmonisation (ages, gaps), outputs (dictionary, figures, theme).
## Adapted from Eu40_APC code/functions_competing.R and code/35_who_causes_full_history.R. data.table.

library(data.table)
eu40_root    <- file.path(here::here(), "..", "Eu40_APC")                  # read-only sources: projects next to this one
estican_root <- file.path(here::here(), "..", "estican")
who_raw   <- file.path(eu40_root, "data", "who_mortality", "raw")           # WHO Mortality Database, February 2026 (read-only)
who_src   <- "WHO Mortality Database, February 2026 release (raw files downloaded from cdn.who.int on 10 October 2026, Eu40_APC NOTES item 2)"
who_files <- c("morticd07/MortIcd7", "morticd08/Morticd8", "morticd09/Morticd9", sprintf("morticd10_part%d/Morticd10_part%d", 1:6, 1:6))
who_xl    <- c(Germany = "mortICD_DEU", Norway = "mortICD_NOR")             # morticd10_add workbooks (file = sheet)
wpp_rds   <- file.path(estican_root, "data", "UNDP", "pop_UN.rds")          # UN WPP population (estican, read-only)
wpp_src   <- "UN World Population Prospects (revision to be confirmed), estican data/UNDP/pop_UN.rds of 2 June 2026 (as used for GLOBOCAN 2024; read-only)"
py_src    <- "person-years WHO, else UN WPP calibrated to WHO by sex and age (NOTES item 84)"
pm_src    <- sprintf("%s; %s; UN WPP: %s", who_src, py_src, wpp_src)                       # provenance of files with WHO deaths and person-years
cap_src   <- sprintf("Source: %s; %s.", sub(" \\(.*", "", who_src), py_src)               # figure captions
who_q     <- file.path(estican_root, "data", "WHO_mortality_data_quality.csv")   # WHO data-quality assessment (estican, read-only)
ac        <- paste0("a", 1:18)                                              # 5-year age groups: 1 = 0-4, ..., 17 = 80-84, 18 = 85+
a3069     <- 7:14                                                           # ages 30-69
okabe     <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#999999", "#000000")

## WHO columns <p>2..<p>25 to the 18 age groups by Frmat (PDF p.8, Annex 1; NS = Norway workbook, ages 0-14 merged).
## Blank cells are merged into the preceding group; groups merged across ages are NA (03/04 75+, 05 70+, 06 65+,
## 07/08 10-year groups, 09 none)
age18 <- function(d, p) {
  stopifnot(all(d$Frmat %in% c(sprintf("%02d", 0:9), "NS")))
  x <- as.matrix(d[, paste0(p, 2:25), with = FALSE]); x[is.na(x)] <- 0
  a <- cbind(rowSums(x[, 1:5, drop = FALSE]), x[, 6:21, drop = FALSE], rowSums(x[, 22:24, drop = FALSE])); f <- d$Frmat
  a[f %in% c("03", "04"), 16:18] <- NA; a[f == "05", 15:18] <- NA; a[f == "06", 14:18] <- NA
  a[f %in% c("07", "08", "09"), ] <- NA; a[f == "NS", 1:3] <- NA
  d[, (ac) := as.data.table(a)][, known := rowSums(x)][]
}

## missing years inside a series in runs of at most `gap` years, interpolated linearly between the bounding years
gaps <- function(y, gap = 3) {
  m <- setdiff(seq(min(y), max(y)), y)
  if (!length(m)) return(NULL)
  r <- data.table(year = m, run = cumsum(c(1L, diff(m) > 1L)))[, n := .N, by = run][n <= gap]
  if (nrow(r)) r[, .(year, lo = min(year) - 1L, hi = max(year) + 1L), by = run][, .(year, lo, hi)]
}
interp <- function(d, id, by, v, gap = 3) {
  g <- d[, gaps(unique(year), gap), by = id]
  if (!nrow(g)) return(NULL)
  b <- d[, c(id, by, "year", v), with = FALSE]
  x <- merge(g, setnames(copy(b), c("year", v), c("lo", "v0")), by = c(id, "lo"), allow.cartesian = TRUE)
  x <- merge(x, setnames(copy(b), c("year", v), c("hi", "v1")), by = c(id, by, "hi"))
  x[, (v) := v0 + (year - lo) / (hi - lo) * (v1 - v0)][, c("v0", "v1") := NULL][]
}

## sources of person-years ('+'-joined labels, e.g. composites) as one sorted '+'-joined label; "none" if empty
src_join <- function(x) if (length(x)) paste(sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(x, "+", fixed = TRUE)))), collapse = "+") else "none"

## md5 of an R object (cache keys; data.tables as lists, functions deparsed)
digest_txt <- function(x) { f <- tempfile(); on.exit(unlink(f)); writeLines(capture.output(dput(x)), f); unname(tools::md5sum(f)) }

## runs of consecutive years as text ("1969-1985, 1987") and the longest run of TRUE values of `ok` over consecutive years
runs_txt <- function(y) {
  y <- sort(unique(y)); if (!length(y)) return(NA_character_)
  r <- split(y, cumsum(c(1L, diff(y) > 1L)))
  paste(vapply(r, function(z) if (length(z) > 1) paste(range(z), collapse = "-") else as.character(z), ""), collapse = ", ")
}
longest_run <- function(y, ok) {
  d <- data.table(y, ok)[order(y)][, k := rleid(ok, cumsum(c(1L, diff(y) > 1L)))][ok == TRUE]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(list(y0 = NA_integer_, y1 = NA_integer_, n = 0L))
  r <- d[, .(y0 = min(y), y1 = max(y), n = .N), by = k][order(-n, -y1)][1]
  list(y0 = r$y0, y1 = r$y1, n = r$n)
}

## Outputs: dictionary rows of one script replaced in <dir>/dictionary.csv (file, variable, description, unit; a
## '(provenance)' row per file gives the source and the script); figures saved as PDF (cairo) and PNG (300 dpi)
dict_update <- function(dir, script, rows, source = who_src) {
  f  <- file.path(dir, "dictionary.csv")
  pr <- data.table(file = unique(rows$file), variable = "(provenance)", description = sprintf("Source: %s. Written by code/%s", source, script), unit = "text")
  rows <- rbind(pr, rows)[order(match(file, pr$file))]
  old <- if (file.exists(f)) fread(f)[!file %like% script] else NULL
  fwrite(rbind(old, rows[, file := sprintf("%s: %s", script, file)], use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE), f)
}
dict_figures <- function(dir, script, figs) {
  f <- file.path(dir, "dictionary.csv")
  fwrite(rbind(fread(f), data.table(file = sprintf("%s: figures/%s.{pdf,png}", script, names(figs)), variable = "(figure)", description = figs,
                                    unit = "PDF (vector) and PNG (300 dpi)")), f)
}
save_both <- function(p, f, w, h) {
  dir.create(dirname(f), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(f, ".pdf"), p, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggplot2::ggsave(paste0(f, ".png"), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
}
th_comp <- function(base = 8) ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = base, base_family = "Arial") +
  ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.25),
                 strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(), strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top",
                 plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base + 1, face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = base - 1, colour = "grey30"),
                 plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = base - 1.5, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0))
code/01_areas.R: Areas; steps ‘Raw files’ and ‘Countries and data quality’ of Table 1.8; writes data/dict/areas.csv, data/dict/dictionary.csv (149 lines; on GitHub) 
## Areas (Step 1): every WHO country code of the WHO Mortality Database (mort_country_codes) with name, ISO3 (countrycode
## from the name; manual fixes below), UN M49 country code, region, sub-region (the area) and intermediate region, names
## and numeric codes (countrycode un, un.region.*, un.regionsub.*, un.regionintermediate.*), national-level and
## sub-national years in the raw mortality files and national years in mort_pop, the WHO data-quality assessment (estican
## WHO_mortality_data_quality.csv, joined on ISO3), and include/exclude with the reason for sub-national, overlapping and
## former codes and countries rated Low by WHO. Composites: United Kingdom = sum of its parts in the year 4308 lacks
## (mort_notes) and Germany = FRG + GDR before 4085 starts. Territory changes (mort_notes) with the population step
## (mort_pop) in `note` and `change_years`.
## Usage (project root): Rscript code/01_areas.R
## Writes data/dict/areas.csv, data/dict/dictionary.csv

source(here::here("code", "functions_pm.R"))
library(countrycode); library(readxl)

cc <- fread(file.path(who_raw, "mort_country_codes", "country_codes"), encoding = "UTF-8")[, .(who_code = country, name)]

## ISO3 from the name; former entities get their ISO 3166-3 codes, sub-national parts NA (countrycode maps USSR to RUS and
## the GDR to DEU)
fix <- c(`1365` = NA, `1470` = "SDN", `2330` = "ANT", `2455` = "VIR", `3070` = "TWN", `3330` = NA, `4040` = "CSK", `4090` = "DDR",
         `4120` = NA, `4304` = "SUN", `4310` = NA, `4320` = NA, `4330` = NA, `4340` = "YUG", `4350` = "SCG")
cc[, iso3 := suppressWarnings(countrycode(name, "country.name", "iso3c"))]
cc[as.character(who_code) %in% names(fix), iso3 := fix[as.character(who_code)]]
m49 <- function(o) suppressWarnings(countrycode(cc$iso3, "iso3c", o))
cc[, `:=`(region = m49("un.region.name"), subregion = m49("un.regionsub.name"), intermediate = m49("un.regionintermediate.name"))]
## not in M49 (historical codes, Taiwan, parts): region of the successor or of the parent country
man <- rbindlist(list(
  list(1365L, "Africa", "Sub-Saharan Africa", "Eastern Africa"), list(2330L, "Americas", "Latin America and the Caribbean", "Caribbean"),
  list(2455L, "Americas", "Latin America and the Caribbean", "Caribbean"), list(3070L, "Asia", "Eastern Asia", NA_character_),
  list(3330L, "Asia", "Eastern Asia", NA_character_), list(4040L, "Europe", "Eastern Europe", NA_character_),
  list(4090L, "Europe", "Western Europe", NA_character_), list(4100L, "Europe", "Western Europe", NA_character_),
  list(4120L, "Europe", "Western Europe", NA_character_), list(4304L, "Europe", "Eastern Europe", NA_character_),
  list(4310L, "Europe", "Northern Europe", NA_character_), list(4320L, "Europe", "Northern Europe", NA_character_),
  list(4330L, "Europe", "Northern Europe", NA_character_), list(4340L, "Europe", "Southern Europe", NA_character_),
  list(4350L, "Europe", "Southern Europe", NA_character_)))
setnames(man, c("who_code", "r", "s", "i"))
cc <- merge(cc, man, by = "who_code", all.x = TRUE)[!is.na(s), `:=`(region = r, subregion = s, intermediate = i)][, c("r", "s", "i") := NULL]
cc[, region_source := fifelse(who_code %in% man$who_code, "manual", "countrycode")]
## M49 numeric codes: regions from their names; countries from ISO3, former entities their historical M49 codes, Taiwan
## its ISO 3166-1 numeric code (as UN WPP; not in M49)
cl <- as.data.table(codelist)
cc[, `:=`(region_code = cl$un.region.code[match(region, cl$un.region.name)], subregion_code = cl$un.regionsub.code[match(subregion, cl$un.regionsub.name)],
          intermediate_code = cl$un.regionintermediate.code[match(intermediate, cl$un.regionintermediate.name)], m49_code = m49("un"))]
m49f <- c(`1470` = 736L, `2330` = 530L, `3070` = 158L, `4040` = 200L, `4090` = 278L, `4100` = 280L, `4304` = 810L, `4340` = 890L, `4350` = 891L)
cc[as.character(who_code) %in% names(m49f), m49_code := m49f[as.character(who_code)]]

## WHO data-quality assessment (completeness, ill-defined or non-specific causes, usability = completeness x (1 - share
## ill-defined); quality High, Medium, Low)
q  <- fread(who_q, na.strings = "")
cc <- merge(cc, q[, .(iso3 = country_iso3, who_completeness = Completeness, who_ill_defined = `Percentage of ill-defined or non-specific causes to total deaths`,
                      who_usability = Usability, who_quality = quality, q_m49 = country_code)], by = "iso3", all.x = TRUE)

## years in the raw mortality files (national: Admin1 and SubDiv blank), national population totals (mort_pop), notes
yc <- c("Country", "Admin1", "SubDiv", "Year")
mr <- rbindlist(c(lapply(who_files, function(f) unique(fread(file.path(who_raw, f), select = yc, colClasses = "character", na.strings = ""))),
                  lapply(names(who_xl), function(f) unique(as.data.table(read_excel(file.path(who_raw, "morticd10_add", paste0(f, ".xlsx")), sheet = who_xl[f], col_types = "text"))[, yc, with = FALSE]))))
mr <- unique(mr[, .(who_code = as.integer(Country), year = as.integer(Year), sub = fcoalesce(Admin1, "") != "" | fcoalesce(SubDiv, "") != "")])
pt <- fread(file.path(who_raw, "mort_pop", "pop"), na.strings = "")[is.na(Admin1) & is.na(SubDiv) & Sex %in% 1:2, .(pop = sum(Pop1)), by = .(who_code = Country, year = Year)]
mn <- fread(file.path(who_raw, "mort_notes", "notes"))
yy <- function(d, nm) d[, setNames(.(.N, runs_txt(year)), paste0(nm, c("_years", "_runs"))), by = who_code]
cc <- merge(merge(cc, yy(mr[sub == FALSE], "mort"), by = "who_code", all.x = TRUE), yy(pt, "pop"), by = "who_code", all.x = TRUE)
cc <- merge(cc, mr[sub == TRUE, .(subnational_mort = runs_txt(year)), by = who_code], by = "who_code", all.x = TRUE)
cc[is.na(mort_years), mort_years := 0L][is.na(pop_years), pop_years := 0L]

yr  <- function(w) mr[who_code %in% w & sub == FALSE, sort(unique(year))]
ovl <- function(a, b) runs_txt(intersect(yr(a), yr(b)))
ny  <- function(w, p = "") mn[country == w & note %like% p, year]
pp  <- function(w, y) pt[who_code == w & year == y, pop]
stp <- function(w, y) paste(vapply(y, function(z) { z0 <- pt[who_code == w & year < z, max(year)]
  sprintf("population %+.1f%% %d to %d", 100 * (pp(w, z) / pp(w, z0) - 1), z0, z) }, ""), collapse = ", ")
uk  <- setdiff(Reduce(intersect, lapply(c(4310, 4320, 4330), yr)), yr(4308)); uk <- uk[uk > min(yr(4308)) & uk < max(yr(4308))]
de  <- c(min(yr(4090)), min(yr(4085)) - 1L)

## include/exclude: sub-national parts, former entities overlapping their successors, codes without national data
ukp <- sprintf("Part of the United Kingdom (4308 is used; 4308 %s = 4310 + 4320 + 4330)", runs_txt(uk))
ex <- c(
  `4310` = ukp, `4320` = ukp, `4330` = ukp,
  `4100` = sprintf("Former entity (FRG): summed with the GDR into Germany 4085 for %d-%d; its population includes West Berlin", de[1], de[2]),
  `4090` = sprintf("Former entity (GDR): summed with the FRG into Germany 4085 for %d-%d", de[1], de[2]),
  `4120` = sprintf("Part of the FRG 4100 (FRG population %.2f million in 1970 includes West Berlin's %.2f million)", pp(4100, 1970) / 1e6, pp(4120, 1970) / 1e6),
  `4040` = sprintf("Former entity: overlaps Czechia (4045) in %s; successor states used", ovl(4040, 4045)),
  `4304` = sprintf("Former entity: overlaps its successor states (e.g. Russian Federation 4272) in %s; successor states used", ovl(4304, 4272)),
  `4340` = sprintf("Former entity: overlaps Croatia, Slovenia and Bosnia and Herzegovina in %s; successor states used", ovl(4340, c(4038, 4276, 4025))),
  `4350` = sprintf("Former entity: overlaps Serbia (from %d) and Montenegro (from %d); successor states used", min(intersect(yr(4350), yr(4273))), min(intersect(yr(4350), yr(4207)))),
  `1470` = "Former entity (Sudan before 2011): no data",
  `1365` = sprintf("Part of Mauritius (1300 includes Rodrigues from %d, mort_notes)", min(ny(1300))),
  `3330` = sprintf("Part of Japan from 1972 (Okinawa; Japan 3160 includes it from 1972); data %s only", runs_txt(yr(3330))),
  `3068` = sprintf("No national-level data: selected urban and rural areas only (Subdiv A35/A41/A51, List 09C %s; < 10%% of deaths, PDF p.39)", runs_txt(mr[who_code == 3068 & sub == TRUE, year])),
  `3283` = "No national-level data: West Bank only (Subdiv A30)")
cc[, `:=`(include = !as.character(who_code) %in% names(ex), reason = ex[as.character(who_code)])]
cc[include == TRUE & mort_years == 0, `:=`(include = FALSE, reason = "No national-level mortality data")]
cc[include == TRUE & who_quality %in% "Low", `:=`(include = FALSE, reason = sprintf("WHO data-quality assessment Low (usability %.1f%%: completeness %.1f%%, ill-defined or non-specific causes %.1f%%)",
                                                                                     who_usability, who_completeness, who_ill_defined))]
cc[, composite := fcase(who_code == 4308L, "4310+4320+4330", who_code == 4085L, "4100+4090", default = NA_character_)]
cc[, composite_years := fcase(who_code == 4308L, runs_txt(uk), who_code == 4085L, sprintf("%d-%d", de[1], de[2]), default = NA_character_)]

## territory changes inside national series (first year of the change; population step from the previous year with data)
chg <- list(`1300` = min(ny(1300)), `3160` = 1972L, `4272` = range(ny(4272, "Exclude")) + 0:1, `4260` = ny(4260), `4084` = ny(4084), `4303` = min(ny(4303)))
sar <- "Special Administrative Region of China (China has no national-level data)"
nt <- c(`4080` = sprintf("Metropolitan France (%.2f million in 2010); overseas departments are separate codes", pp(4080, 2010) / 1e6),
        `1300` = sprintf("Includes Rodrigues (1365) from %d (mort_notes)", chg$`1300`),
        `3160` = "Includes Okinawa (Ryu Kyu Islands, 3330) from 1972",
        `4272` = sprintf("Excludes Chechnya %s (mort_notes)", runs_txt(ny(4272, "Exclude"))),
        `4260` = sprintf("Excludes Transnistria and Bender from %d (mort_notes)", chg$`4260`),
        `4084` = sprintf("Excludes Abkhazia and South Ossetia from %d (mort_notes)", chg$`4084`),
        `4303` = sprintf("Excludes non-government-controlled areas in %s (mort_notes)", runs_txt(ny(4303))),
        `4273` = sprintf("Excludes Kosovo from %d, the first year of the series (mort_notes)", ny(4273)),
        `2450` = "50 states and DC; Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands are separate codes", `3070` = "Not in UN M49; placed in Eastern Asia",
        `3090` = sar, `3220` = sar, `3080` = "Government-controlled areas (mort_notes)")
nt[names(chg)] <- paste0(nt[names(chg)], "; ", vapply(names(chg), function(w) stp(as.integer(w), chg[[w]]), ""))
cc[, `:=`(note = nt[as.character(who_code)], change_years = vapply(as.character(who_code), function(w) if (is.null(chg[[w]])) NA_character_ else paste(chg[[w]], collapse = ";"), ""))]
qm <- cc[q_m49 != m49_code, paste(sprintf("%s %d (%d)", iso3, who_code, m49_code), collapse = ", ")]
cc[, q_m49 := NULL]
setcolorder(cc, c("who_code", "name", "iso3", "m49_code", "region", "region_code", "subregion", "subregion_code", "intermediate", "intermediate_code", "region_source",
                  "include", "reason", "who_completeness", "who_ill_defined", "who_usability", "who_quality", "composite", "composite_years", "mort_years", "mort_runs",
                  "pop_years", "pop_runs", "subnational_mort", "note", "change_years"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cc$who_code), !anyNA(cc$subregion), !anyNA(cc$subregion_code), !nrow(cc[include == TRUE & (is.na(iso3) | is.na(m49_code))]))
fwrite(cc[order(who_code)], here::here("data", "dict", "areas.csv"))

dict_update(here::here("data", "dict"), "01_areas.R", source = paste0(who_src, ": mort_country_codes, raw mortality files, mort_pop and mort_notes; countrycode ", packageVersion("countrycode"),
                                                                      " (UN M49); WHO data-quality assessment, estican data/WHO_mortality_data_quality.csv of 2 June 2026 (read-only)"),
  data.table(file = "areas.csv", variable = names(cc), description = c(
  "WHO country code (mort_country_codes)", "WHO name", "ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (countrycode from the name; former entities ISO 3166-3; NA for sub-national parts)",
  "UN M49 numeric country code (countrycode from ISO3; former entities their historical M49 code; Taiwan 158, ISO 3166-1 numeric as in UN WPP; NA for sub-national parts)",
  "UN M49 region", "UN M49 numeric region code", "UN M49 sub-region (the area of the area series)", "UN M49 numeric sub-region code (area_code of the area outputs)",
  "UN M49 intermediate region (NA where none)", "UN M49 numeric intermediate region code (NA where none)",
  "countrycode or manual (codes not in M49: former entities, Taiwan, parts)", "TRUE: eligible as a constituent of an area series",
  "Reason for include = FALSE",
  "WHO data-quality assessment (joined on ISO3; NA: not assessed): completeness of death registration", "WHO data-quality assessment: ill-defined or non-specific causes, share of total deaths",
  "WHO data-quality assessment: usability = completeness x (1 - ill-defined or non-specific share)", "WHO data-quality assessment: High, Medium or Low (in the file: usability >= 80%, 60-80%, < 60%); Low is not eligible; NA where not rated",
  "Codes summed to fill the composite years", "Years filled by the composite",
  "Years with national-level mortality rows (Admin1 and SubDiv blank) in the raw files (ICD-7 to ICD-10, Germany and Norway workbooks)", "Those years as runs",
  "Years with national-level population (mort_pop)", "Those years as runs", "Years with sub-national mortality rows (Admin1 or SubDiv) in the raw files",
  "Note: coverage and territory changes (mort_notes) with the step in total population (mort_pop, both sexes) from the previous year with data",
  "First years of territory changes inside the national series (';'-separated)"),
  unit = c("code", "text", "code", "code", "text", "code", "text", "code", "text", "code", "text", "logical", "text", "percent", "percent", "percent", "text",
           "code", "calendar years", "count of years", "calendar years", "count of years", "calendar years", "calendar years", "text", "calendar years")))

cat(sprintf("%d WHO codes: %d included, %d excluded; %d with national-level mortality data\n", nrow(cc), cc[include == TRUE, .N], cc[include == FALSE, .N], cc[mort_years > 0, .N]))
cat(sprintf("WHO data-quality assessment: %d codes with an assessment (joined on ISO3; %s); M49 code differs from the file's for %s\n", cc[!is.na(who_completeness), .N],
            cc[!is.na(who_completeness), .N, by = .(q = fcoalesce(who_quality, "not rated"))][, paste(q, N, collapse = ", ")], qm))
print(cc[mort_years > 0 & (who_quality %in% "Low" | (!is.na(who_completeness) & is.na(who_quality))), .(who_code, name, iso3, subregion, who_completeness, who_ill_defined, who_usability, who_quality, include)])
cat(sprintf("Included codes with mortality data not assessed by WHO: %s\n", cc[include == TRUE & mort_years > 0 & is.na(who_completeness), paste(iso3, collapse = " ")]))
cat(sprintf("Composites (population): United Kingdom %s: 4308 %s, parts %s; Germany %d: 4085 %s, FRG + GDR %s\n", runs_txt(uk),
            format(sum(pp(4308, uk)), big.mark = ","), format(pt[who_code %in% c(4310, 4320, 4330) & year %in% uk, sum(pop)], big.mark = ","),
            min(yr(4085)), format(pp(4085, min(yr(4085))), big.mark = ","), format(pt[who_code %in% c(4100, 4090) & year == min(yr(4085)), sum(pop)], big.mark = ",")))
print(cc[include == FALSE & mort_years > 0 | !is.na(composite) | !is.na(subnational_mort), .(who_code, name, iso3, subregion, include, mort = mort_runs, sub = subnational_mort, reason = substr(reason, 1, 70))], nrows = 50)
cat("\nNotes:\n"); print(cc[!is.na(note), .(who_code, name, change_years, note)])
cat("\nCodes by sub-region (included, with mortality data):\n")
print(cc[include == TRUE & mort_years > 0, .(n = .N, codes = paste(iso3, collapse = " ")), by = .(region, subregion)][order(region, subregion)])
code/02_cause_groups.R: Cause groups; steps ‘Causes across ICD revisions’ of Table 1.8; writes data/dict/who_cause_groups.csv, data/dict/dictionary.csv (68 lines; on GitHub) 
## Cause groups (Step 2): copy of the Eu40_APC dictionary (data/dict/who_cause_groups.csv, read-only) extended to the lists
## used outside Europe (09A = 09B codes, Table 5; 08B, Table 4; S47 in 09A/09B) and to the SDG 3.4 groups: lung (trachea,
## bronchus and lung cancer, C33-C34), crd (chronic respiratory diseases, J30-J98), copd44 (J40-J44, ICD-10 detailed lists
## only) and copd in 09N. Every row cites the WHO documentation page (PDF page; printed page = PDF page - 2). ncd4 =
## cancer + cvd + diabetes + crd is computed in code/03_who_deaths.R. China's 09C list (Table 7) is not needed: China has
## sub-national data only (data/dict/areas.csv).
## Usage (project root): Rscript code/02_cause_groups.R
## Writes data/dict/who_cause_groups.csv, data/dict/dictionary.csv

source(here::here("code", "functions_pm.R"))
eu <- fread(file.path(eu40_root, "data", "dict", "who_cause_groups.csv"), colClasses = c(list = "character", codes = "character"))

r <- function(list, group, codes, match, sign, required, source, note = "") data.table(list, group, codes, match, sign, required, source, note)
add <- rbind(
  ## 09A: same codes as 09B (PDF p.9: '09A,09B' = ICD-9 Basic Tabulation List; Table 5)
  copy(eu[list == "09B"])[, `:=`(list = "09A", source = paste0("PDF p.9 (printed 7; 09A and 09B share Table 5); ", source))],
  r(c("09A", "09B"), "chapters", "S47", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.35 (printed 33)", "All accidental causes where B47-B52 are not broken down (Bahamas 1983)"),
  r(c("09A", "09B"), "external", "S47", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.35 (printed 33)", "Replaces B47-B52 (Bahamas 1983); disjoint from B47-B56 (B00 identity)"),
  ## 08B (Table 4, PDF p.27-28)
  r("08B", "all", "B000", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "All causes"),
  r("08B", "chapters", "B001-B050", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27-28 (printed 25-26)", "Mutually exclusive B items (B018 and B046 residuals); used only to check the all-cause code"),
  r("08B", "cancer", "B019", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "ICD-8 140-209 (includes 208-209, as 08A)"),
  r("08B", "cvd", "B025-B030", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "ICD-8 390-438 only: 440-458 are in the residual B046"),
  r("08B", "ihd", "B028", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "ICD-8 410-414"),
  r("08B", "stroke", "B030", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "ICD-8 430-438"),
  r("08B", "external", "B047-B050", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.28 (printed 26)", "E800-E999"),
  r("08B", "suicide", "B049", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.28 (printed 26)", "E950-E959"),
  r("08B", "ill_defined", "B045", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.28 (printed 26)", "ICD-8 780-796"),
  r("08B", "diabetes", "B021", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "ICD-8 250"),
  r("08B", "copd", "B033", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "ICD-8 490-493, as 08A A093"),
  r("08B", "liver_disease", "B037", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.27 (printed 25)", "ICD-8 571 (cirrhosis of liver) only, as 08A A102"),
  ## lung: trachea, bronchus and lung (ICD-10 C33-C34)
  r("07A", "lung", "A050", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.15 (printed 13)", "ICD-7 162-163 (163: lung not specified as primary or secondary); 07B: inside B018 (not isolable)"),
  r("08A", "lung", "A051", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.22 (printed 20)", "ICD-8 162; 08B: inside B019 (not isolable)"),
  r(c("09A", "09B"), "lung", "B101", "exact", 1, TRUE, "PDF p.30 (printed 28)", "ICD-9 162; sub-item of B10; NA where B101 is not reported"),
  r("09N", "lung", "B101", "exact", 1, TRUE, "PDF p.30 and p.38 (printed 28 and 36)", "ICD-9 162; sub-item of S08 (CH02)"),
  r("101", "lung", "1034", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.42 (printed 40)", "C33-C34; sub-item of 1026"),
  r(c("103", "104"), "lung", "C33-C34", "prefix3", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.42 (printed 40; row 1034)", ""),
  r("10M", "lung", "C33-C34", "prefix3", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.10 and p.42 (printed 8 and 40)", "UE1: UE15 is C32-C34 (larynx included; PDF p.45), not isolable"),
  ## crd: chronic respiratory diseases (ICD-10 J30-J98)
  r("08A", "crd", "A093-A096", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.23 (printed 21)", "ICD-8 490-519 (490-493 bronchitis emphysema asthma; 500 tonsils; 510 513 empyema abscess; 501-508 511 512 514-519 other). ICD-7 is NA: asthma (241) is in A066 with endocrine disorders (PDF p.15) and 07B/08B have the rest in residuals (PDF p.19-20 and p.28)"),
  r(c("09A", "09B"), "crd", "B32", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.32-33 (printed 30-31)", "ICD-9 490-519 = B32 (466, 480-519) - B320 - B321 - B322; 470-478 (chronic upper respiratory, J30-J39) are not included: they are in B31 with acute infections and 09A does not report B311-B319"),
  r(c("09A", "09B"), "crd", "B320;B321;B322", "exact", -1, TRUE, "PDF p.32-33 (printed 30-31)", "Acute bronchitis (466), pneumonia (480-486), influenza (487) subtracted; NA where any is not reported"),
  r("09N", "crd", "B323;S329", "exact", 1, TRUE, "PDF p.33 and p.38 (printed 31 and 36)", "ICD-9 490-493 + S329 (rest of B31 and B32: B313-B315, B319, B324-B327, B329 = 470-478, 494-519); sub-items of CH08 (= S310 + B321 + B322 + B323 + S329, verified)"),
  r("101", "crd", "1076;1077", "exact", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.43 (printed 41)", "J40-J47 + J00-J06, J30-J39, J60-J98: includes J00-J06 (acute upper respiratory infections, not separable; share of J30-J98 in output/data_build/respiratory_checks.csv). UE1: not isolable (CH10 - UE38 - UE39 keeps J00-J06 and J20-J22; PDF p.45-46)"),
  r(c("103", "104"), "crd", "J30-J98", "prefix3", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.43 (printed 41; rows 1076 and 1077) and ICD-10 codes", "J99 is an asterisk code"),
  r("10M", "crd", "J30-J98", "prefix3", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.10 and p.43 (printed 8 and 41)", ""),
  ## copd44 (J40-J44): ICD-10 detailed lists only
  r(c("103", "104"), "copd44", "J40-J44", "prefix3", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.43 (printed 41; row 1076 J40-J47) and ICD-10 codes", "Not isolable elsewhere: asthma is inside 101 1076 (J40-J47), UE1 UE40 (J40-J47; UE41 = J45-J46 but J47 stays), ICD-9 B323 (490-493) and ICD-8 A093/B033 (490-493)"),
  r("10M", "copd44", "J40-J44", "prefix3", 1, FALSE, "PDF p.10 and p.43 (printed 8 and 41)", ""),
  ## copd in 09N
  r("09N", "copd", "B323", "exact", 1, TRUE, "PDF p.33 and p.38 (printed 31 and 36)", "ICD-9 490-493 only, as ICD-8 A093: 494-496 are inside S329 (approximation; validated at the 09N List transitions)")
)
grp <- rbind(eu, add)[, required := as.logical(required)]
grp <- grp[order(match(list, c("07A", "07B", "08A", "08B", "09A", "09B", "09N", "101", "103", "104", "10M", "UE1")))]
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(grp[, .(list, group, codes, sign)]), !nrow(grp[source == "" | is.na(source)]))
fwrite(grp, here::here("data", "dict", "who_cause_groups.csv"))

dict_update(here::here("data", "dict"), "02_cause_groups.R", source = "Eu40_APC data/dict/who_cause_groups.csv (read-only copy) extended from the WHO Mortality Database documentation (February 2026 release, raw/mort_documentation)",
  data.table(file = "who_cause_groups.csv", variable = names(grp), description = c(
  "WHO List", "Group (chapters = mutually exclusive top-level codes, used only to check the all-cause code)",
  "Codes or ranges as in the Cause column, ';'-separated", "exact: Cause; prefix3: first 3 characters of Cause (3- and 4-character rows both added)",
  "+1 added, -1 subtracted", "TRUE: every code of the row must be reported in the country-year, otherwise the group is NA (sub-items of condensed lists)",
  "WHO documentation page (PDF page; printed page in brackets) or empirical correction", "Note"),
  unit = c("code", "text", "WHO cause codes (ICD-7 to ICD-10)", "text", "+1/-1", "logical", "text", "text")))
cat(sprintf("who_cause_groups.csv: %d rows (%d from Eu40_APC, %d added)\n", nrow(grp), nrow(eu), nrow(add)))
print(dcast(grp[!group %in% c("chapters")][, .N, by = .(group, list)], group ~ list, value.var = "N", fill = 0)[
  group %in% c("all", "cancer", "cvd", "ihd", "stroke", "external", "ill_defined", "covid", "diabetes", "copd", "copd44", "lung", "crd")])
code/03_who_deaths.R: WHO deaths and population; steps ‘Raw files’, ‘Countries and data quality’, ‘Ages’, ‘Causes across ICD revisions’, ‘Coding changes’, ‘Ill-defined causes’, ‘Gaps and interpolation’ and ‘Population’ of Table 1.8; writes data/derived/{who_deaths, who_checks}.rds, data/derived/dictionary.csv, output/data_build/{list_transitions, group_overlap, respiratory_checks, population_sources, population_seams, dictionary}.csv (425 lines; on GitHub) 
## WHO deaths and population (Step 3): deaths by country (WHO code), year, sex, 5-year age group (1 = 0-4, ..., 18 = 85+)
## and cause group (data/dict/who_cause_groups.csv; ncd4 = cancer + cvd + diabetes + crd) for every country and year of
## the WHO Mortality Database raw files (national level: Admin1 and SubDiv blank; ICD-7 to ICD-10, Germany 2021-22 and
## Norway 2017-24 workbooks), with the method of Eu40_APC code/35_who_causes_full_history.R: the all-cause code of each
## List is identified empirically and must be the documented one; ages harmonised row by row from Frmat; unknown age
## redistributed proportionally within each group (all-cause by age = sum of its exclusive parts); interior gaps of up
## to 3 years interpolated linearly. Person-years: WHO population (mort_pop), age formats harmonised, gaps of up to 3
## years interpolated; other cells of country-years with deaths (year missing, ages merged) take UN WPP (estican
## pop_UN.rds, by UN M49 code) calibrated to WHO by sex and age (WHO/WPP ratio averaged over the 3 nearest years with both
## on each side: held constant beyond the first or last WHO year, interpolated linearly between two), uncalibrated where
## a country has no WHO population.
## Composites (data/dict/areas.csv): United Kingdom 2000 = 4310 + 4320 + 4330, Germany 1969-1989 = FRG 4100 + GDR 4090.
## Validation: List transitions (share of all deaths at 30-69 changing by more than 15%), group overlaps, respiratory
## diagnostics (NOTES items 10-13), WPP seams (ratios outside 0.9-1.1, step at the seam), and deaths identical to
## Eu40_APC causes_full_history.rds where both exist.
## Usage (project root): Rscript code/03_who_deaths.R   (national raw extract and one chunk per country and List cached
## in data/derived/cache/03/: the extract keyed on the md5 of the raw files and of keep(), chunks on the md5 of the
## expanded cause groups and of the chunk code)
## Writes data/derived/{who_deaths,who_checks}.rds, data/derived/dictionary.csv, output/data_build/{list_transitions,
##        group_overlap,respiratory_checks,population_sources,population_seams,dictionary}.csv

source(here::here("code", "functions_pm.R")); library(readxl)

t0      <- proc.time()
dir_out <- here::here("output", "data_build")
dir_d   <- here::here("data", "derived")
dir_c   <- file.path(dir_d, "cache", "03")
dir.create(dir_c, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
core    <- c("cancer", "cvd", "external", "ill_defined", "covid")         # with other: mutually exclusive, sum to all
n4      <- c("cancer", "cvd", "diabetes", "crd")                           # ncd4 (SDG 3.4)
show    <- c("cancer", "cvd", "ihd", "stroke", "external", "ill_defined", "diabetes", "crd", "copd", "lung", "ncd4")
dc      <- paste0("Deaths", 1:26)
areas   <- fread(here::here("data", "dict", "areas.csv"), na.strings = "")
ctry    <- areas[, .(who_code, country = name)]

## cause groups: ";"-separated codes or ranges (A044-A059, 1027-1046, CH01-CH17; prefix3 ranges may span letters, V01-Y89)
expand <- function(x, match) unlist(lapply(strsplit(x, ";")[[1]], function(r) {
  b <- strsplit(r, "-")[[1]]
  if (length(b) == 1) return(r)
  if (match == "prefix3") {
    k <- function(z) (utf8ToInt(substr(z, 1, 1)) - 65L) * 100L + as.integer(substr(z, 2, 3))
    s <- k(b[1]):k(b[2])
    return(sprintf("%s%02d", LETTERS[s %/% 100 + 1], s %% 100))
  }
  n <- sub("^[A-Z]+", "", b)
  sprintf(paste0(sub("[0-9]+$", "", b[1]), "%0", nchar(n[1]), "d"), as.integer(n[1]):as.integer(n[2]))
}))
f_grp <- here::here("data", "dict", "who_cause_groups.csv")
grp   <- fread(f_grp, colClasses = c(list = "character", codes = "character"))
gexp  <- grp[, .(code = expand(codes, match)), by = .(id = seq_len(nrow(grp)), list, group, match, s = sign, required)]
gl    <- c(setdiff(unique(grp$group), "chapters"), "other", "oth_residual", "ncd4")
oth   <- grep("^oth_", setdiff(gl, "oth_residual"), value = TRUE)          # exclusive components of other (with oth_residual)

## ----- raw files (national level, every country), cached -----
keep <- function(d, src) {
  d <- d[fcoalesce(Admin1, "") == "" & fcoalesce(SubDiv, "") == ""]
  d[, c("Country", "Year", "Sex") := lapply(.SD, as.integer), .SDcols = c("Country", "Year", "Sex")]
  d[, (dc) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = dc][, c("Country", "Year", "List", "Cause", "Sex", "Frmat", dc), with = FALSE][, src := src][]
}
fx    <- c(file.path(who_raw, who_files), file.path(who_raw, "morticd10_add", paste0(names(who_xl), ".xlsx")))
f_raw <- file.path(dir_c, sprintf("raw_national_%s.rds", digest_txt(list(unname(tools::md5sum(fx)), deparse(keep), who_xl))))
unlink(setdiff(list.files(dir_c, "^raw_national_", full.names = TRUE), f_raw))   # stale extract
if (file.exists(f_raw)) dr <- readRDS(f_raw) else {
  dr <- rbindlist(c(lapply(who_files, function(f) { message("reading ", f); keep(fread(file.path(who_raw, f), colClasses = list(character = 1:9), na.strings = ""), basename(f)) }),
                    lapply(names(who_xl), function(f) keep(as.data.table(read_excel(file.path(who_raw, "morticd10_add", paste0(f, ".xlsx")), sheet = who_xl[f], col_types = "text")), paste0(f, ".xlsx")))))
  stopifnot(!nrow(dr[, uniqueN(src), by = .(Country, Year)][V1 > 1]), !nrow(dr[, uniqueN(List), by = .(Country, Year)][V1 > 1]))
  saveRDS(dr, f_raw)
}
stopifnot(all(dr$List %chin% grp$list))

## ----- one (country, List) chunk: all-cause check, groups by age, unknown age, NA rules -----
chunk <- function(d, L) {
  d  <- age18(d[Sex %in% 1:2], "Deaths")[, unk := fcoalesce(Deaths26, 0)]
  g  <- gexp[list == L]
  cz <- unique(d$Cause)
  m  <- rbind(g[match == "exact" & code %chin% cz, .(Cause = code, group, s)],
              merge(data.table(Cause = cz, code = substr(cz, 1, 3)), g[match == "prefix3", .(code, group, s)], by = "code", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[, .(Cause, group, s)])
  ch  <- d[Cause %chin% m[group == "chapters", Cause], .(chap = sum(Deaths1, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(Year, Sex)]
  chk <- merge(d[, .(Year, Sex, Cause, Deaths1)], ch, by = c("Year", "Sex"), all.x = TRUE)[
    , .(total = paste(Cause[which(Deaths1 == max(Deaths1, na.rm = TRUE) & Deaths1 >= fcoalesce(chap, 0))], collapse = ";"),
        chapters_equal = isTRUE(abs(max(Deaths1, na.rm = TRUE) - chap[1]) <= 0.5)), by = .(Year, Sex)]
  fmt <- d[Cause == g[group == "all", code], .(frmat = paste(sort(unique(Frmat)), collapse = "/"), src = src[1]), by = Year]
  vv  <- c(ac, "unk", "known", "total")
  x <- merge(d[, c("Cause", "Year", "Sex", ac, "unk", "known"), with = FALSE][, total := d$Deaths1], m[group != "chapters"], by = "Cause", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
  x <- x[, (vv) := lapply(.SD, `*`, s), .SDcols = vv][, lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(Year, Sex, group), .SDcols = vv]
  x <- merge(CJ(Year = unique(d$Year), Sex = 1:2, group = setdiff(gl, c("other", "oth_residual", "ncd4"))), x, by = c("Year", "Sex", "group"), all.x = TRUE)
  x[group %chin% g$group & is.na(known), (vv) := 0]                   # top-level codes absent in a year = 0 deaths
  if (!"covid" %chin% g$group) x[group == "covid" & Year < 2020, (vv) := 0]   # Lists without a COVID-19 code end before 2020
  x <- merge(x, x[group == "all", c("Year", "Sex", ac), with = FALSE], by = c("Year", "Sex"), suffixes = c("", "_all"))
  for (a in ac) set(x, which(is.na(x[[paste0(a, "_all")]])), a, NA_real_)
  x[, paste0(ac, "_all") := NULL]
  rq <- g[required == TRUE]                                             # sub-items: absent = not reported
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rq))) x[group == rq$group[i] & !Year %in% d[Cause == rq$code[i], Year], (vv) := NA]
  x[group == "hiv" & Year < 1987, (vv) := NA]                            # no comparable HIV code before 1987
  x[group == "infectious" & ((L == "08A" & Year >= 1985) | (L %in% c("09A", "09B") & Year >= 1987 & !Year %in% d[Cause == "B184", Year])), (vv) := NA]   # HIV not separable
  ## Ireland 2000-06: B184 reported as 0 in both sexes between 18 HIV deaths at 20-59 in 1999 and 15 in 2007 (HIV coded elsewhere)
  if (L == "09B" && d$Country[1] == 4170L) x[group %chin% c("hiv", "infectious") & Year %in% 2000:2006, (vv) := NA]
  if (L %in% c("07A", "08A", "09A", "09B")) x[group %chin% c("suicide", "undetermined") & Year %in% d[Cause == "CH17" & Deaths1 > 0, Year], (vv) := NA]
  if (L %in% c("103", "104", "10M")) {
    e <- merge(d, m[group == "external"], by = "Cause")[, .(y34 = sum(Deaths1[substr(Cause, 1, 3) == "Y34"], na.rm = TRUE), ext = sum(Deaths1, na.rm = TRUE)), by = Year]
    x[group %chin% c("suicide", "undetermined", "drug_related", "alcohol_specific") & Year %in% e[ext > 0 & y34 >= 0.98 * ext, Year], (vv) := NA]
  }
  x[group != "all" & Year %in% d[src == "Germany.xlsx", Year], (vv) := NA]     # cells < 3 suppressed: all-cause only
  o <- copy(x[group %chin% c("all", core)])[group != "all", (vv) := lapply(.SD, `-`), .SDcols = vv][
    , lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(Year, Sex), .SDcols = vv]
  x <- rbind(x, o[, group := "other"], use.names = TRUE)                  # other from the raw counts (every column)
  r <- copy(x[group %chin% c("other", oth)])[group != "other", (vv) := lapply(.SD, `-`), .SDcols = vv][
    , lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(Year, Sex), .SDcols = vv]
  x <- rbind(x, r[, group := "oth_residual"], use.names = TRUE)
  rmin <- dcast(x[group %chin% c("other", "oth_residual"), .(v = suppressWarnings(min(unlist(.SD), na.rm = TRUE))), by = .(Year, Sex, group), .SDcols = c(ac, "unk", "total")
                  ][, group := paste0(group, "_raw_min")], Year + Sex ~ group, value.var = "v")
  x[, (ac) := lapply(.SD, `*`, fifelse(known > 0, 1 + unk / known, fifelse(unk == 0, 1, NA_real_))), .SDcols = ac]   # unknown age, by group
  x[group == "dementia", (ac[1:12]) := NA_real_]                        # dementia: ages 60+ only
  ro <- merge(x[group == "other", c("Year", "Sex", ac), with = FALSE], x[group %chin% c(oth, "oth_residual"), lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(Year, Sex), .SDcols = ac],
              by = c("Year", "Sex"), suffixes = c("", ".s"))
  for (a in ac) set(ro, j = a, value = fifelse(ro[[paste0(a, ".s")]] > 0, ro[[a]] / ro[[paste0(a, ".s")]], 1))
  i  <- x[, which(group %chin% c(oth, "oth_residual"))]
  f  <- ro[x[i, .(Year, Sex)], on = c("Year", "Sex")]
  for (a in ac) set(x, i, a, x[[a]][i] * f[[a]])                         # oth_* scaled to other by age (sum = other)
  pt <- x[group %chin% c(core, "other"), lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(Year, Sex), .SDcols = ac]
  al <- merge(x[group == "all"], pt, by = c("Year", "Sex"), suffixes = c("", ".p"))           # all-cause by age = sum of its parts
  for (a in ac) { p <- al[[paste0(a, ".p")]]; set(al, which(!is.na(p)), a, p[!is.na(p)]) }
  x <- rbind(x[group != "all"], al[, names(x), with = FALSE])[, `:=`(who_code = d$Country[1], list = L)]
  n <- x[group %chin% n4, c(lapply(.SD, sum), list(group = "ncd4")), by = .(Year, Sex, who_code, list), .SDcols = c(ac, "total")]
  x <- rbind(x, n, fill = TRUE)                                          # ncd4 = cancer + cvd + diabetes + crd (NA if any is NA)
  setnames(x, c("Year", "Sex"), c("year", "sex"))
  list(age = melt(x[, c("who_code", "list", "year", "sex", "group", ac), with = FALSE], measure.vars = ac, variable.name = "age", value.name = "deaths")[, age := as.integer(sub("a", "", age))],
       tot = x[, .(who_code, list, year, sex, group, total)],
       chk = chk[, .(who_code = d$Country[1], list = L, year = Year, sex = Sex, total, chapters_equal)],
       rmin = rmin[, .(who_code = d$Country[1], year = Year, sex = Sex, other_raw_min, oth_residual_raw_min)],
       fmt = fmt[, .(who_code = d$Country[1], year = Year, frmat)])
}
## chunk key: md5 of the expanded cause groups (dictionary and expand()) and of the chunk code (chunk(), age18() and the
## objects they use), so that edits after this point do not force a rebuild
key <- digest_txt(list(as.list(gexp), deparse(chunk), deparse(age18), core, n4, gl, oth, ac))
unlink(grep(key, list.files(dir_c, "^chunk_", full.names = TRUE), value = TRUE, invert = TRUE))   # stale chunks
cl  <- unique(dr[, .(Country, List)])[order(Country, List)]
res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cl)), function(i) {
  w <- cl$Country[i]; L <- cl$List[i]
  f <- file.path(dir_c, sprintf("chunk_%d_%s_%s.rds", w, L, key))
  if (file.exists(f)) return(readRDS(f))
  message(sprintf("%3d/%d %d %s List %s %s", i, nrow(cl), w, ctry[who_code == w, country], L, paste(range(dr[Country == w & List == L, Year]), collapse = "-")))
  r <- chunk(dr[Country == w & List == L], L)
  saveRDS(r, f); r
})
pick <- function(k) rbindlist(lapply(res, `[[`, k), fill = TRUE)

## ----- all-cause code per List: empirical (largest and >= the chapter codes) vs documented -----
tc <- merge(pick("chk"), grp[group == "all", .(list, doc = codes)], by = "list")
tc[, ok := mapply(function(t, d) d %chin% strsplit(t, ";")[[1]], total, doc)]
cat("All-cause code: documented vs empirical, (country, year, sex) cells\n")
print(tc[, .(doc = doc[1], empirical = names(which.max(table(unlist(strsplit(total, ";"))))), cells = .N, cells_ok = sum(ok)), by = list])
bad <- tc[ok == FALSE]
if (nrow(bad)) {
  cat("Cells where the documented all-cause code is not the largest code (set to NA):\n")
  print(merge(bad, ctry, by = "who_code")[, .(sexes = paste(sex, collapse = ","), empirical = total[1]), by = .(who_code, country, list, year)])
}

## ----- interior missing years, population, composites, save -----
dt  <- pick("age")[, interpolated := FALSE]
tot <- pick("tot")
if (nrow(bad)) { dt <- dt[!bad, on = c("who_code", "year", "sex")]; tot <- tot[!bad, on = c("who_code", "year", "sex")] }
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(dt, by = c("who_code", "year", "sex", "age", "group")))
cyl <- unique(dt[, .(who_code, year, list)])
ip  <- interp(dt, "who_code", c("sex", "age", "group"), "deaths")
ip  <- merge(merge(ip, cyl[, .(who_code, lo = year, l0 = list)], by = c("who_code", "lo")), cyl[, .(who_code, hi = year, l1 = list)], by = c("who_code", "hi"))
dt  <- rbind(dt, ip[, .(who_code, list = fifelse(l0 == l1, l0, paste(l0, l1, sep = "/")), year, sex, group, age, deaths, interpolated = TRUE)], use.names = TRUE)
iy  <- unique(ip[, .(who_code, year, lo, hi)])                          # bounding observed years of the interpolated years

pw <- fread(file.path(who_raw, "mort_pop", "pop"), colClasses = list(character = c("Admin1", "SubDiv", "Frmat")), na.strings = "")
pw <- age18(pw[fcoalesce(Admin1, "") == "" & fcoalesce(SubDiv, "") == "" & Sex %in% 1:2], "Pop")   # Pop26 (age unknown) dropped
pw <- melt(pw[, c("Country", "Year", "Sex", ac), with = FALSE], measure.vars = ac, variable.name = "age", value.name = "py")[, age := as.integer(sub("a", "", age))]
setnames(pw, c("Country", "Year", "Sex"), c("who_code", "year", "sex"))
pop <- rbind(pw[, py_source := "WHO"], interp(pw, "who_code", c("sex", "age"), "py")[, .(who_code, year, sex, age, py, py_source = "WHO (interpolated)")])
## WPP where a country-year with deaths has no WHO person-years (year missing, or ages merged): WHO/WPP ratio by sex and
## age, mean over the 3 nearest WHO years on each side (rb: this and 2 earlier, ra: this and 2 later) rolled to the
## gap; ratio 1 for countries without any WHO population
un <- merge(areas[!is.na(m49_code), .(who_code, m49_code)], readRDS(wpp_rds)[, .(m49_code = as.integer(country_code), year = as.integer(year), sex = as.integer(sex),
                                                                                  age = as.integer(age), un = py)], by = "m49_code")[, m49_code := NULL]
rt <- merge(pw[!is.na(py)], un, by = c("who_code", "year", "sex", "age"))[order(who_code, sex, age, year)][, r := py / un]
rt[, `:=`(rb = frollmean(r, pmin(seq_len(.N), 3L), adaptive = TRUE), ra = rev(frollmean(rev(r), pmin(seq_len(.N), 3L), adaptive = TRUE))), by = .(who_code, sex, age)]
pop <- pop[!is.na(py)]
fl <- un[unique(dt[, .(who_code, year)]), on = c("who_code", "year"), nomatch = NULL][!pop, on = c("who_code", "year", "sex", "age")]
fl[, c("lo", "r0") := rt[fl, .(x.year, rb), on = c("who_code", "sex", "age", "year"), roll = Inf]]
fl[, c("hi", "r1") := rt[fl, .(x.year, ra), on = c("who_code", "sex", "age", "year"), roll = -Inf]]
fl[, `:=`(ratio = fcase(!is.na(lo) & !is.na(hi), r0 + (year - lo) / (hi - lo) * (r1 - r0), !is.na(lo), r0, !is.na(hi), r1, !who_code %in% rt$who_code, 1),
          py_source = fifelse(who_code %in% rt$who_code, "WPP calibrated", "WPP"))][, py := un * ratio]
pop <- rbind(pop, fl[!is.na(py), names(pop), with = FALSE])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pop, by = c("who_code", "year", "sex", "age")))
dt  <- merge(dt, pop, by = c("who_code", "year", "sex", "age"), all.x = TRUE)[, composite := FALSE]

cm <- areas[!is.na(composite)]
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cm))) {
  p <- as.integer(strsplit(cm$composite[i], "+", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]); y <- as.integer(strsplit(cm$composite_years[i], "-")[[1]]); y <- seq(y[1], y[length(y)])
  x <- dt[who_code %in% p & year %in% y][, np := uniqueN(who_code), by = year][np == length(p)]
  x <- x[, .(deaths = sum(deaths), py = sum(py), list = paste(sort(unique(list)), collapse = "+"), interpolated = any(interpolated),
             py_source = paste(sort(unique(py_source)), collapse = "+")), by = .(year, sex, age, group)]
  stopifnot(!nrow(dt[who_code == cm$who_code[i] & year %in% x$year & interpolated == FALSE]))   # replaces interpolated years only
  dt <- rbind(dt[!(who_code == cm$who_code[i] & year %in% x$year)], x[, `:=`(who_code = cm$who_code[i], composite = TRUE)], use.names = TRUE)
  tx <- tot[who_code %in% p & year %in% x$year][, np := uniqueN(who_code), by = year][np == length(p)]   # all-ages totals: observed parts only
  tot <- rbind(tot, tx[, .(total = sum(total), list = paste(sort(unique(list)), collapse = "+")), by = .(year, sex, group)][, who_code := cm$who_code[i]], use.names = TRUE)
}
dt <- merge(dt, ctry, by = "who_code")
dt <- dt[order(who_code, year, sex, match(group, gl), age), .(who_code, country, year, sex, age, group, deaths, py, list, interpolated, composite, py_source)]
saveRDS(dt, file.path(dir_d, "who_deaths.rds"))

## ----- population sources (country-years with deaths: sources at ages 30-69 and at all ages) and WPP seams (the WHO
## year next to WPP years, by sex and age) -----
ids <- areas[, .(who_code, iso3, m49_code, country = name)]
ps  <- dt[group == "all", .(py_source_3069 = src_join(py_source[!is.na(py) & age %in% a3069]), py_source_all = src_join(py_source[!is.na(py)])), by = .(who_code, year)]
ps  <- merge(ids, ps[, .(n_years = .N, years = runs_txt(year)), by = .(who_code, py_source_3069, py_source_all)], by = "who_code")[order(who_code, py_source_3069, py_source_all)]
sm  <- rbind(fl[!is.na(lo), .(side = "after", year_wpp = min(year), ratio = r0[1]), by = .(who_code, sex, age, year_who = lo)],
             fl[!is.na(hi), .(side = "before", year_wpp = max(year), ratio = r1[1]), by = .(who_code, sex, age, year_who = hi)])
sm[rt, on = .(who_code, sex, age, year_who = year), `:=`(py_who = i.py, un_who = i.un)][fl, on = .(who_code, sex, age, year_wpp = year), `:=`(py_wpp = i.py, un_wpp = i.un)]
sm  <- merge(ids, sm, by = "who_code")[order(who_code, year_who, side, sex, age)]
sm[, `:=`(ratio_who = py_who / un_who, ratio_wpp = py_wpp / un_wpp)][, `:=`(step = ratio_wpp / ratio_who - 1, flag = abs(ratio - 1) > 0.1)]
fwrite(ps, file.path(dir_out, "population_sources.csv"))
smo <- sm[, .(who_code, iso3, m49_code, country, side, year_who, year_wpp, sex, age, ratio, ratio_who, ratio_wpp, step, flag)]
fwrite(smo, file.path(dir_out, "population_seams.csv"))

## ----- checks by (country, year, sex): ill-defined shares, groups sum to all-cause, raw disjointness -----
w   <- c(all = 1, setNames(rep(-1, length(core) + 1), c(core, "other")))
ck  <- rbind(dt[group %chin% names(w), .(d = sum(deaths * w[group]), o = deaths[group == "other"]), by = .(who_code, year, sex, age)],
             tot[group %chin% names(w), .(age = 0L, d = sum(total * w[group]), o = total[group == "other"]), by = .(who_code, year, sex)], use.names = TRUE)
ck  <- ck[, .(sum_diff = if (all(is.na(d))) NA_real_ else max(abs(d), na.rm = TRUE), other_min = if (all(is.na(o))) NA_real_ else min(o, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(who_code, year, sex)]
rmn <- pick("rmin")[, .(who_code, year, sex, other_raw_min = fifelse(is.finite(other_raw_min), other_raw_min, NA_real_))]
cx  <- unique(pick("chk")[, .(who_code, year, sex, chapters_equal)])
iy  <- iy[unique(dt[interpolated == TRUE & composite == FALSE, .(who_code, year)]), on = c("who_code", "year"), nomatch = 0]
bound <- function(x, v, f) {                                            # interpolated years: worst case of the bounding observed years
  b <- merge(merge(iy, setnames(copy(x), c("year", v), c("lo", "v0")), by = c("who_code", "lo"), allow.cartesian = TRUE),
             setnames(copy(x), c("year", v), c("hi", "v1")), by = c("who_code", "hi", "sex"))
  rbind(x, setnames(b[, .(who_code, year, sex, f(v0, v1))], "V4", v), use.names = TRUE)
}
rmn <- bound(rmn, "other_raw_min", pmin)
cx  <- bound(cx, "chapters_equal", `&`)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cm))) {                                          # composites: worst case over the parts
  p <- as.integer(strsplit(cm$composite[i], "+", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]); yc <- dt[who_code == cm$who_code[i] & composite == TRUE, unique(year)]
  rmn <- rbind(rmn, rmn[who_code %in% p & year %in% yc, .(who_code = cm$who_code[i], other_raw_min = min(other_raw_min)), by = .(year, sex)], use.names = TRUE)
  cx <- rbind(cx, cx[who_code %in% p & year %in% yc, .(who_code = cm$who_code[i], chapters_equal = all(chapters_equal)), by = .(year, sex)], use.names = TRUE)
}
ill <- dt[age %in% a3069 & group %chin% c("all", "ill_defined"), .(d = sum(deaths)), by = .(who_code, year, sex, group)]
ill <- dcast(rbind(ill, ill[, .(sex = 0L, d = sum(d)), by = .(who_code, year, group)]), who_code + year + sex ~ group, value.var = "d")[, ill_share_3069 := ill_defined / all]
cys <- merge(merge(merge(ck, rmn, by = c("who_code", "year", "sex"), all.x = TRUE), cx, by = c("who_code", "year", "sex"), all.x = TRUE),
             ill[sex > 0, .(who_code, year, sex, ill_share_3069)], by = c("who_code", "year", "sex"), all = TRUE)
cys <- rbind(cys, ill[sex == 0, .(who_code, year, sex, ill_share_3069)], fill = TRUE)
cys[, check := sum_diff < 1e-6 & other_min >= -1e-9 & other_raw_min >= 0]
cys <- merge(cys, merge(unique(dt[, .(who_code, country, year, list, interpolated, composite)]), pick("fmt"), by = c("who_code", "year"), all.x = TRUE), by = c("who_code", "year"))
saveRDS(cys[order(who_code, year, sex)], file.path(dir_d, "who_checks.rds"))

## ----- List transitions: last year of the old List vs first year of the new one, both sexes, ages 30-69 -----
yl <- unique(dt[interpolated == FALSE & composite == FALSE, .(who_code, year, list)])[order(who_code, year)]
tr <- yl[, .(list_old = shift(list), year_old = shift(year), list_new = list, year_new = year), by = who_code][!is.na(list_old) & list_old != list_new]
m4 <- dt[age %in% a3069 & composite == FALSE, .(deaths = sum(deaths), py = sum(py)), by = .(who_code, year, group)]
m4 <- merge(m4, m4[group == "all", .(who_code, year, all = deaths)], by = c("who_code", "year"))[, `:=`(share = deaths / all, rate = 1e5 * deaths / py)]
ta <- tot[, .(total = sum(total)), by = .(who_code, year, group)]
m4 <- merge(m4, merge(ta, ta[group == "all", .(who_code, year, all = total)], by = c("who_code", "year"))[, .(who_code, year, group, share_all_ages = total / all)],
            by = c("who_code", "year", "group"), all.x = TRUE)[, c("py", "all") := NULL]
tj <- merge(merge(tr, m4, by.x = c("who_code", "year_old"), by.y = c("who_code", "year")), m4,
            by.x = c("who_code", "year_new", "group"), by.y = c("who_code", "year", "group"), suffixes = c("_old", "_new"))
tj[, `:=`(jump_share = share_new / share_old - 1, jump_count = deaths_new / deaths_old - 1, jump_rate = rate_new / rate_old - 1)]
tj[, `:=`(flag = abs(jump_share) > 0.15, count_jump = abs(jump_count) > 0.15)]
tj <- merge(ctry, tj, by = "who_code")[order(who_code, year_old, match(group, gl)),
  .(who_code, country, list_old, list_new, year_old, year_new, group, deaths_old, deaths_new, rate_old, rate_new, share_old, share_new,
    share_all_ages_old, share_all_ages_new, jump_share, jump_count, jump_rate, flag, count_jump)]
fwrite(tj, file.path(dir_out, "list_transitions.csv"))

## ----- non-exclusive groups: codes shared by two groups of a List (same code, a 4-character code in a 3-character one, a
## sub-item in its parent item: PDF p.15, 22, 30, 38, 43-46); 'other' = codes in none of cancer, cvd, external, ill_defined, covid -----
par <- data.table(list = rep(c("07A", "08A", "09A", "09B", "09N", "101", "UE1"), c(2, 2, 2, 2, 4, 3, 5)),
                  code = c("1550", "156", "155", "1978", "1551", "1552", "1551", "1552", "B27", "B29", "B54", "B101", "1067", "1069", "1101", "UE13", "UE34", "UE36", "UE63", "UE65"),
                  a = c("A057", "A057", "A058", "A058", "B09", "B09", "B09", "B09", "CH07", "CH07", "CH17", "S08", "1064", "1064", "1095", "UE07", "CH09", "CH09", "CH20", "CH20"))
rng <- function(x) {                                                    # consecutive codes as ranges
  d <- data.table(x = unique(x))[, `:=`(p = sub("[0-9]+$", "", x), n = sub("^[A-Z]*", "", x))][, `:=`(w = nchar(n), i = suppressWarnings(as.integer(n)))]
  d <- d[order(p, w, i)][, b := cumsum(c(TRUE, !(diff(i) %in% 1L) | p[-1] != p[-.N] | w[-1] != w[-.N]))]
  paste(sort(d[, if (.N > 1) paste(x[1], x[.N], sep = "-") else x, by = b]$V1), collapse = "; ")
}
ov <- rbindlist(lapply(unique(grp$list), function(L) {
  g  <- gexp[list == L & !group %chin% c("all", "chapters"), .(s = sum(s)), by = .(group, code)]
  an <- unique(rbind(g[s > 0, .(code, a = code)], g[s > 0 & nchar(code) == 4, .(code, a = substr(code, 1, 3))], par[list == L & code %chin% g$code, .(code, a)]))
  mb <- merge(an, g[s > 0, .(a = code, group)], by = "a")[!merge(an, g[s < 0, .(a = code, group)], by = "a"), on = c("code", "group")]
  mb <- unique(mb[, .(code, group)])
  mb <- rbind(mb, data.table(code = setdiff(mb$code, mb[group %chin% core, code]), group = "other"))
  p  <- merge(mb, mb, by = "code", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[match(group.x, gl) < match(group.y, gl)]
  p  <- p[!merge(an[a != code], p, by.x = "a", by.y = "code")[, .(code, group.x, group.y)], on = c("code", "group.x", "group.y")]   # parent listed: drop sub-items
  p[, .(n_codes = .N, codes = rng(code)), by = .(group_1 = group.x, group_2 = group.y)][, list := L]
}))
ov <- ov[order(match(list, unique(grp$list)), match(group_1, gl), match(group_2, gl)), .(list, group_1, group_2, n_codes, codes)]
stopifnot(!nrow(ov[group_1 %chin% c(core, oth) & group_2 %chin% c(core, oth)]),   # partition and oth_* share no code
          !nrow(ov[group_1 %chin% n4 & group_2 %chin% n4]))                         # ncd4 parts are mutually exclusive in every List
fwrite(ov, file.path(dir_out, "group_overlap.csv"))

## ----- respiratory diagnostics (NOTES items 10-13): observed country-years, ages 30-69, both sexes; ICD-10 detailed Lists
## (3-character codes) and ICD-9 09A/09B country-years reporting B324 or B325 -----
rd <- age18(dr[Sex %in% 1:2 & ((List %chin% c("103", "104", "10M") & Cause %like% "^J") | (List %chin% c("09A", "09B") & Cause %chin% c("B323", "B324", "B325")))], "Deaths")
rd <- rd[, .(d = sum(rowSums(.SD))), .SDcols = ac[a3069], by = .(who_code = Country, year = Year, list = List, code = fifelse(List %like% "^09", Cause, substr(Cause, 1, 3)))]
rd <- rd[, if (!anyNA(d) && (list[1] %like% "^10" || any(code %chin% c("B324", "B325")))) .SD, by = .(who_code, year, list)]
jc <- function(a, b) sprintf("J%02d", a:b)
rsh <- function(nm, num, den) rd[, .(measure = nm, numerator = sum(d[code %chin% num]), denominator = sum(d[code %chin% den])), by = .(who_code, year, list)]
rc <- rbind(rsh("J30-J39 / J30-J98", jc(30, 39), jc(30, 98)), rsh("J00-J06 / J30-J98", jc(0, 6), jc(30, 98)), rsh("J45-J47 / J40-J47", jc(45, 47), jc(40, 47)),
            rsh("B324-B325 / B323-B325 (ICD-9 494-496 / 490-496)", c("B324", "B325"), c("B323", "B324", "B325")))[denominator > 0][, share := numerator / denominator]
rc <- merge(areas[, .(who_code, iso3, country = name)], rc, by = "who_code")[order(measure, who_code, year), .(who_code, iso3, country, list, year, measure, numerator, denominator, share)]
fwrite(rc, file.path(dir_out, "respiratory_checks.csv"))

## ----- dictionaries -----
dict_update(dir_d, "03_who_deaths.R", source = pm_src, data.table(

## ----- acceptance checks -----

            sm[age %in% a3069, sum(flag)], sm[age %in% a3069, .N], sm[, sum(flag)], nrow(sm), nrow(a1), median(abs(a1$step)), max(abs(a1$step)), a1[abs(step) > 0.02, .N]))

print(sp[include == TRUE, .(iso3, side, year_who, year_wpp, r_wpp = round(r_wpp, 3), cells = sprintf("%.3f-%.3f", r_min, r_max), n_out = sprintf("%d/%d", n_out, n), step = round(step, 4))], nrows = 300)

eu <- readRDS(file.path(eu40_root, "data", "who_mortality", "causes_full_history.rds"))
cmp <- merge(eu[, .(who_code, year, sex, age, group, deaths_eu = deaths, py_eu = py, src_eu = py_source)],
             dt[composite == FALSE, .(who_code, year, sex, age, group, deaths, py)], by = c("who_code", "year", "sex", "age", "group"))

print(cmp[!is.na(deaths_eu) & !is.na(deaths), .(cells = .N, max_abs_diff = max(abs(deaths - deaths_eu))), by = group][order(-max_abs_diff)])
print(cmp[is.na(deaths_eu) != is.na(deaths), .(cells = .N, years = runs_txt(year)), by = .(group, eu40_na = is.na(deaths_eu))])
